column1: # The golden set for scripts/ops/bench-recall.sh
# question <TAB> the filename that should answer it
# Hand-written against the real corpus on the VM. A label is a claim about what
# the workspace actually contains, so when a document is deleted or renamed, its
# lines have to change with it — otherwise the benchmark starts scoring the
# label rather than retrieval.
# Keep the questions phrased the way a person would ask them; a question written
# in the corpus's own words makes every retriever look good.
which migration dropped Spanish from the locale enum
how does the abandoned extraction reaper decide a document is stuck
what happens when a password is changed
what does the doctor check about backups
how do I restore a backup into a throwaway database
what does the lock checker refuse
which colours are in the design system palette
what happens in the opening episode of the red button
what did I write about a dedicated physical iPhone
which image identity did I ask to lock
show me the cinematic character sheet
what does the midnight detective look like
